facts.text: Proposal: single storey rear extension to a semi-detached house.
Extension projects 3.0 m from the rear wall; footprint 18 sq m.
Walls in red brick to match the existing house; grey concrete roof tiles to match.
Existing private garden 120 square metres; 102 square metres retained after the extension.

retrieved_policies.heading: Policy H3 Residential extensions
retrieved_policies.text: Extensions to dwellings are supported where: (a) the extension is subordinate in scale to the host dwelling; (b) materials match or complement the host dwelling; (c) there is no significant loss of light or outlook to a habitable room of a neighbouring dwelling, and a projection of more than 3.0 m beyond the rear wall of an attached neighbour is presumed to cause such loss; (d) at least 50 per cent of the private garden area is retained.

retrieved_policies.heading: Policy D1 Design quality
retrieved_policies.text: Development shall use external materials that complement the host building and the street. Where the materials are not specified on the drawings, a condition requiring samples to be agreed before the relevant works begin will be imposed.

reasons.finding: The 3.0 m projection (site-plan-A) is within the H3(c) presumption and 102 of 120 square metres of garden is retained, so criteria (a), (c) and (d) are met.
Brick and tiles to match the host (elevation-B) comply with D1.

conditions.text: The external materials shall be those specified on drawing elevation-B and retained as such.
